Metadata.title: Scholens
Metadata.description: Read, organize, and ask across your research with Scholens.

promotion.title: Keep Scholens within reach
promotion.description: Open it from your Home Screen without browser controls.

ios.title: Add Scholens to your Home Screen
ios.description: Safari installs Scholens from its Share menu.
ios.step3: Confirm Add. Scholens will open in its own window.

android.title: Install Scholens
android.description: Use your browser’s app installation command.
android.step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
android.step3: Confirm Install. Scholens will appear with your other apps.

in-app.title: Open Scholens in your browser
in-app.description: WeChat’s in-app browser cannot install Scholens directly.
in-app.step1: Open the page menu in this browser.
in-app.step2: Choose Open in browser to continue in Safari or Chrome.
in-app.step3: Use that browser’s Add to Home Screen or Install app command.

InstallExperience.firstLaunch: Scholens is installed. Sign in once on this device to continue.

metadata.title: Scholens MCP documentation
metadata.description: Connect Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients to your Scholens research workspace.

hero.title: Connect your research agent to Scholens
hero.description: Give Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any Streamable HTTP client secure access to {count} tools for your stored research knowledge.

quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.description: Create one scoped key, connect your client, and verify the Scholens catalog before beginning research work.

create.title: Create a key
create.description: Open Settings → Access keys and grant only the permissions this client needs.

copy.title: Save the secret
copy.description: Copy the key immediately. Scholens shows the complete secret only once.

connect.title: Connect MCP
connect.description: Choose your client below and keep the key in its environment or private configuration.

verify.title: Verify tools
verify.description: Restart the client, inspect the Scholens server, and confirm that the expected tools are visible.

setup.title: Connect a client
setup.description: Use the remote endpoint for normal tool and resource access. Use the official local connector when an agent must upload a PDF from your repository.
setup.officialReference: Open the client's official MCP documentation

remote.title: Remote Streamable HTTP
remote.description: The simplest path for stored knowledge, Projects, collaboration, annotations, and jobs. Every request sends an Access Key as a Bearer token.

local.title: Local uvx connector
local.description: Adds safe repository PDF upload without opening an inbound port or exposing an absolute local path.

localUpload.title: Upload local PDFs safely
localUpload.description: The local connector replaces the remote upload-preparation tool with upload_local_paper. Files must be beneath an exposed MCP root or --allowed-root, must be valid PDFs, and may not exceed {size} MB.
localUpload.releasePinned: This production guide pins the uvx connector to Scholens release {sha}.
localUpload.developmentFallback: Development preview: the connector uses mutable @main. Production builds replace it with their exact 40-character release SHA.
localUpload.showConfiguration: Show the reusable local connector configuration

codex.label: Codex
codex.description: Codex app, CLI, and IDE extension share the same config.toml MCP configuration. Keep the secret in SCHOLENS_ACCESS_KEY and reference the environment variable from the server entry.
codex.after: Save the file, then restart the Codex app or IDE extension. In Codex CLI, use /mcp to inspect the connected server.

claude-desktop.label: Claude Desktop
claude-desktop.description: Use the Scholens local stdio bridge in Claude Desktop. This supports the existing Access Key contract, adds repository PDF upload, and avoids the remote custom-connector flow that does not currently accept a static Bearer token.
claude-desktop.after: On macOS, use ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json; on Windows, use %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. Replace YOUR_ACCESS_KEY only in this private file, restart Claude Desktop, then inspect Connectors from the composer.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Configure the remote endpoint in a project .cursor/mcp.json or the global Cursor MCP configuration, and inject the key from the environment.
cursor.after: Reload Cursor after saving the configuration and check MCP settings for the Scholens connection and available tools.

generic.label: Generic MCP
generic.description: Any MCP host that supports Streamable HTTP and Authorization headers can connect directly to the Scholens endpoint.
generic.after: Send the Access Key as a Bearer token on every MCP request. Do not put it in the endpoint URL or commit it to source control.

permissions.title: Choose the minimum permissions
permissions.description: Permissions filter which tools a key can see. Start with read and add authority only for the workflows the client must perform.

items.read: Search and read stored papers, Projects, annotations, Library state, and existing research outputs.
items.write: Create or update research content, upload known sources, and start asynchronous ingestion jobs.
items.manage: Manage collaborators, invitations, ownership changes, and public-sharing state.
items.delete: Run destructive lifecycle operations after an explicit state-bound confirmation.

permissions.authorization: Tool visibility is only the first check. Scholens authorizes the concrete Project, paper, annotation, or output again for every request.

capabilities.title: What the MCP server can do
capabilities.description: A fully authorized remote or local connection exposes {count} tools across six durable research workflows.

papers.title: Stored papers
papers.description: Search, bounded content retrieval, citation context, and source download.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Papers, membership, invitations, ownership, and durable project manifests.

library.title: Personal Library
library.description: Library membership, sharing, and tags while preserving user ownership.

ingestion.title: Ingestion
ingestion.description: Single or batch known-source ingestion, upload preparation, and bounded job waiting.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: Annotation threads and comments for personal or Project-scoped discussion.

outputs.title: Research outputs
outputs.description: Read existing outputs already stored in Scholens.

boundary.title: Deliberate product boundary
boundary.description: Scholens manages and retrieves research knowledge already stored in the workspace. Its MCP server does not discover literature on the public internet and does not generate new research outputs.

binding.title: Bind a research repository
binding.description: Call create_project or get_project once, then save the returned binding_markdown in the repository's AGENTS.md or README.md.
binding.guidance: Use the immutable Project UUID and scholens:// URI in later calls. Never select a Project by its editable title.

security.title: Keep credentials and actions bounded
security.description: Access Keys are powerful agent credentials. Treat their storage, permissions, and confirmations as part of the research boundary.

items.store: Keep keys in environment variables or private client configuration. Never place them in URLs, logs, screenshots, or source control.
items.leastPrivilege: Use the shortest practical expiration and the minimum permission set for each client.
items.confirm: Destructive or externally visible tools return a state-bound preview first and execute only when the same call is repeated with its unexpired confirmation token.
items.upload: The local connector sends the Access Key only to Scholens. Object-storage uploads use separate checksummed authorization.

unauthorized.title: 401 Unauthorized
unauthorized.description: The key is missing, expired, revoked, or copied incorrectly. Create or export a valid key, then restart the client.

missingTool.title: An expected tool is missing
missingTool.description: The Access Key does not include the permission that exposes the tool. Edit the key or create a narrowly scoped replacement.

restart.title: The client still shows an old configuration
restart.description: Restart Codex or Claude Desktop, or reload Cursor, after changing MCP configuration or environment variables.

localFile.title: A local PDF is rejected
localFile.description: Expose the repository as an MCP root or pass --allowed-root. The file must be a non-empty PDF no larger than {size} MB and must remain beneath the allowed root.

longOperation.title: Ingestion has not finished
longOperation.description: Ingestion is asynchronous. Poll get_job with the returned job UUID instead of uploading the paper again.

FoundationSmoke.description: The independent Next.js, token, theme, query, component, and internationalization foundation is running. Product routes intentionally begin later.
